text: Hello, everyone.Welcome to my class.Today, we are going to focus on critical thinking, performing hypotheses, and giving possible explanations.By the end of this period, you are expected to First, sort out and analyze the key information in the main text of this unit.Second, put forward your own predictions on an unsolved mystery and give a reasonable explanation.Before we get started, please get your textbook and worksheet ready.Are you ready?Okay, let's go.In this unit, do you still remember some mysterious places?In reading A, we got to know the British cultural icon, a prehistoric monument, one of the UNESCO World Heritage sites, Stonehenge.The text touches upon the mysteries about its origins and meanings by explaining the three phases of its construction and many theories about this mysterious site.In grammar in use, we were interested in the story of the Loch Ness Monster.In listening part, the stone statues on Easter Island were quite amazing and it is still unknown to us who built the stone statues on the island and why, which is most mysterious about the land of the giants.In viewing part, seeing China's Chang'e 4 probe making a historic landing on Moon's far side, we are excited and proud.Also, what we are aiming for is sending humans to the Moon, studying samples from the Moon and building a research station on the Moon.For a better life and a shared future, hard work and cooperation are in need.There seems to be no end to humanity's appetite for exploring our surroundings and the unknown.In reading B, we further our visual trip to the most unknown and mysterious places on Earth.Mariana Trench, with the Challenger deep, was regarded as one of the least explored parts of the world.Val do Javari, home to one of the largest indigenous territories in Brazil and a great variety of species, due to the thick plants and extreme geographic location, is isolated from the public.But entering the region is prohibited by Brazilian law and protected by a local organization.Singidebemaraha, another UNESCO World Heritage Site besides Stonehenge in this unit, is famous for its needle-shaped limestone formations, which also poses dangers to explorers.So guys, how do you feel about these mysteries?Thank you for watching!I am also curious about that, and I think it is the curiosity that drives us to explore the unknown.What is still unknown about them?What hypotheses have been proposed to explain these mysteries?How do people explain these hypotheses?Let's use a diagram to analyze.For example, about Stonehenge, we wonder about the reason why it was built, which could be puzzle one here.And many experts believe that Stonehenge was built as an observatory or a calendar.We may explain like this.The important stones point to different positions of the sun or the moon.It may be used to predict eclipses and summer and winter solstices.For the question why was it built, you may have another hypothesis and also give some explanations.Besides, there might be other puzzles according to what we have learned in reading A.Thank you both.You just made very objective comments and I want to add that they have few grammatical mistakes, which is also a shining point.For suggestions, maybe the interviewer could ask some detailed questions, which might help the communication go more smoothly.Here is today's assignment.Please finish the integrated tasks part in student's workbook.Now, please interact with your teacher and classmates.The older army was in amazing color the instant it was discovered, but it lost color within five minutes of contact with the air.Out of curiosity, we might want to see more and explore the unknown.Qin Shi Hua Mausoleum is still not explored and excavated.Do you think that it should be excavated?Similarly, with many puzzles in our mind and many hypotheses put forward, how can we balance the relationship between exploring the unknown and protecting the unknown?Please interact with your teacher and your classmates.That's all for today.Thank you for your time with me.Next period, we will have the writing session.Please get ready.
